svg.title: Scattering angle controls the loss of directional momentum
svg.desc: Wavevectors before and after one elastic event have the same length. The example deflects through 60 degrees, leaving k cos(theta) in the incoming direction and losing k[1-cos(theta)]. A separate curve shows 1-cos(theta) from zero through pi, with the same 60-degree example marked. The physical momentum-component loss is hbar times this wavevector-component loss. Vectors live in wavevector space.
